name: table-tap-monorepo
description: Table-Tap Monorepo - Landing Page & Main App

scripts.build: npm run build:app && npm run build:landing
scripts.build:app: cd table-tap-app && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:landing: cd table-tap-landing && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd table-tap-app && npm install && cd ../table-tap-landing && npm install
